title.zh: 分子氢弹性碰撞频率聚合

summary: Per spatial cell, aggregate the molecular elastic Alpha frequencies and the branch-time SIG_H2_H2 re-contraction into the H2-H+, H2-H, H2-H2 and total elastic Omega frequencies, the H2 bulk x-flow velocity, and the perpendicular second moment feeding the Wpp floor.

identity.relation: Omega_H2_P[k] = max(sum(Vr2pidVr * ((Alpha_H2_P[:,:,k]*fH2[:,:,k]) @ dVx)) / (nH2[k]*DeltaVx), 0) with DeltaVx = sign((VxH2[k]-vxi[k])/Vth) * max(|(VxH2[k]-vxi[k])/Vth|, DeltaVx_tol); Omega_H2_H[k] = max(sum(Vr2pidVr * ((Alpha_H2_H[:,:,k]*fH2[:,:,k]) @ dVx) / (nH2[k]*DeltaVx)), 0) against the atomic-H flow VxH with the denominator INSIDE the sum (source-exact ordering); Omega_H2_H2[k] = max(sum(Vr2pidVr * ((Alpha_H2_H2*fH2[:,:,k]) @ dVx)) / (nH2[k]*Wpp), 0) with Alpha_H2_H2 = F^-1(SIG_H2_H2 @ F(fH2[:,:,k])) re-contracted at branch time; Omega_EL = Omega_H2_P + Omega_H2_H + Omega_H2_H2; VxH2[k] = Vth * sum(Vr2pidVr * (fH2[:,:,k] @ (vx*dVx))) / nH2[k].
identity.direction: molecular Alpha frequencies (Alpha_H2_P, Alpha_H2_H) + SIG_H2_H2 matrix + branch-time state (fH2, nH2, MH2_H2_sum) + mesh/weights (Vr2pidVr, dVx, vr, vx) + flow targets (Vth, vxi, VxH) + projection kernel (vr2_2vx2_2D) -> three elastic Omega families, their total, the bulk x-flow velocity VxH2, and the perpendicular second moment Wperp_paraH2
identity.definition: The saved source's per-cell Omega block (kinetic_h2.py:1232-1296): each elastic channel reduces the pointwise Alpha*fH2 product over the velocity mesh and divides by the density times a sign-floored drift difference (or the floored perpendicular second moment for the H2-H2 viscosity channel); the H2-H2 channel re-contracts Alpha_H2_H2 from SIG_H2_H2 with the branch-time fH2 through the legacy Fortran-order Work carrier. The legacy symbolic sign is preserved. Source-exact operator ordering: the Omega_H2_P denominator (nH2[k]*DeltaVx) divides OUTSIDE the sum (kinetic_h2.py:1257) while the Omega_H2_H denominator divides INSIDE (kinetic_h2.py:1270) -- preserved for bit-identical reproduction. All three Omega families are clamped at zero. Wperp_paraH2 dual branch (kinetic_h2.py:1279-1287): sum(MH2_H2_sum) < 0 selects the direct vr2-2*(vx-VxH2/Vth)^2 projection; otherwise the accumulated-moment reduction. NOTE the < 0 test (the atomic side uses <= 0), so a zero accumulator takes the else path -- the path exercised by the registered probe evidence.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim with documented fail-closed hardenings (see verification and known_limitations)
identity.geometry: per spatial cell k: velocity-space quadrature reductions over the (nvr,nvx) slice, producing one scalar per (nx,) output field
identity.coordinates: cylindrical (vr,vx) velocity space, v/vth normalized; Vth in m/s (or the caller's normalized speed); densities source-discrete; the callable performs no implicit unit conversion
identity.boundary: finite aligned inputs of the declared shapes; nH2 entries must be positive wherever any elastic channel is enabled; Vth, DeltaVx_tol, Wpp_tol must be finite positive scalars; the three Omega families are clamped at zero so no negative cells occur
assumptions: The Alpha frequencies arrive from the molecular contraction and the SIG_H2_H2 matrix from the molecular collision-matrix assembly; this operator performs no assembly or gating of its own beyond the documented re-contraction.
The DeltaVx_tol=0.01 and Wpp_tol=0.001 floors are source hardcoded defaults; their physical adequacy is an expert-review item.
No external atomic-physics reference is bound: the saved package records that residual as validation_oracle_gap.

inputs.name: fH2
inputs.description: Molecular neutral H2 velocity distribution at branch time, one (nvr,nvx) slice per spatial cell.
inputs.constraints: Finite; shape (nvr,nvx,nx) exactly; its leading axes define N = nvr*nvx for SIG_H2_H2.

inputs.name: nH2
inputs.description: Molecular H2 density per spatial cell.
inputs.constraints: Finite 1-D of size nx; entries must be positive wherever any elastic channel is enabled (registered hardening: the saved arm silently skipped the Omega block and returned zeros).

inputs.name: Alpha_H2_P
inputs.description: H2-H+ elastic Alpha frequency field (molecular contraction output).
inputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled measure)

inputs.name: Alpha_H2_H
inputs.description: H2-H elastic Alpha frequency field (molecular contraction output).
inputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled measure)

inputs.name: SIG_H2_H2
inputs.description: H2-H2 elastic collision matrix (molecular collision-matrix assembly output), re-contracted against the branch-time fH2.
inputs.constraints: Finite; 2-D square with order exactly nvr*nvx.

inputs.name: Vr2pidVr
inputs.constraints: Finite 1-D of size nvr; entries nonnegative.

inputs.name: dVx
inputs.constraints: Finite 1-D of size nvx; entries positive.

inputs.name: Vth
inputs.description: H2 thermal speed used to normalize the drift difference.
inputs.constraints: Finite and positive (registered hardening: the saved arm validates nothing here and a zero Vth would silently produce non-finite outputs).

inputs.name: vxi
inputs.description: Ion flow velocity per spatial cell, the Omega_H2_P drift target.

inputs.name: VxH
inputs.description: Atomic-H flow velocity per spatial cell, the Omega_H2_H drift target (kinetic_h2.py:1267).

inputs.name: MH2_H2_sum
inputs.description: Accumulated H2-H2 elastic moment at branch time; its sign total selects the Wperp_paraH2 branch.

inputs.name: vr2_2vx2_2D
inputs.description: vr^2 - 2*vx^2 projection kernel on the (vr,vx) mesh, used by the accumulated-moment branch.

inputs.name: DeltaVx_tol
inputs.constraints: Finite and positive scalar (registered hardening: a NaN tolerance bypasses the saved arm's `tol <= 0` check).

inputs.name: Wpp_tol
inputs.constraints: Finite and positive scalar (registered hardening as for DeltaVx_tol).

inputs.name: H2_P_EL
inputs.description: Enable flag for the Omega_H2_P channel.

inputs.name: H2_H_EL
inputs.description: Enable flag for the Omega_H2_H channel.

inputs.name: H2_H2_EL
inputs.description: Enable flag for the Omega_H2_H2 channel and the Wperp_paraH2 projection.

outputs.name: VxH2
outputs.description: H2 bulk x-flow velocity per spatial cell.
outputs.constraints: Finite (fail closed otherwise); zero where all channels are disabled.

outputs.name: Omega_H2_P
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled measure)
outputs.constraints: Finite; nonnegative (zero-clamped by the source semantics).

outputs.name: Omega_H2_H
outputs.description: H2-H elastic collision frequency (denominator inside the sum, source-exact).
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled measure)

outputs.name: Omega_H2_H2
outputs.description: H2-H2 elastic (viscosity) collision frequency from the branch-time SIG_H2_H2 re-contraction.
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled measure)

outputs.name: Omega_EL
outputs.description: Total elastic collision frequency, the exact channel sum.
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled measure)
outputs.constraints: Finite; equals Omega_H2_P + Omega_H2_H + Omega_H2_H2 exactly.

outputs.name: Wperp_paraH2
outputs.description: Perpendicular second moment feeding the Wpp floor of the H2-H2 channel.
outputs.constraints: Finite; selected by the sign of sum(MH2_H2_sum) (< 0: direct vr2 projection; >= 0: accumulated-moment reduction).

preconditions: Branch-time state (fH2, nH2, MH2_H2_sum), upstream Alpha fields and the assembled SIG_H2_H2 matrix exist with aligned shapes.
The caller supplies the mesh, weights, flow targets and floors; this operator performs no gridding or cache handling.
supported: Molecular elastic Omega aggregation (Omega_H2_P, Omega_H2_H, Omega_H2_H2, Omega_EL) with VxH2 and Wperp_paraH2 on a declared velocity carrier.
excluded: The atomic H aggregation, the Omega_* composition into scattered-source sums (elastic-frequency-channels / elastic-regeneration-aggregation consumers), Do_Alpha_*/Do_Sig_Gating, KH2.Internal cache lifecycle, and external physical validation.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when any array argument is misaligned (SIG_H2_H2 not (N,N) square for the carrier, nH2/vxi/VxH not (nx,), Alpha/MH2_H2_sum not (nvr,nvx,nx), weights/kernel mismatched), when any entry is non-finite, when nH2 has a non-positive entry while any elastic channel is enabled, when Vth/DeltaVx_tol/Wpp_tol is not a finite positive scalar, or when a tolerance is non-positive.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if any returned field aggregates to a non-finite value; no partial results are returned.

python.signature: assemble_molecular_hydrogen_omega_frequencies(fH2, nH2, Alpha_H2_P, Alpha_H2_H, SIG_H2_H2, Vr2pidVr, dVx, vr, vx, Vth, vxi, VxH, MH2_H2_sum, vr2_2vx2_2D, DeltaVx_tol=0.01, Wpp_tol=0.001, H2_P_EL=True, H2_H_EL=True, H2_H2_EL=True)

example.description: Aggregate the molecular Omega family on a small carrier from the r66/r67 upstream outputs and check the total is the exact channel sum.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import (
    assemble_molecular_hydrogen_collision_matrices,
    contract_molecular_hydrogen_alpha_frequencies,
    assemble_molecular_hydrogen_omega_frequencies,
)
nvr, nvx, nx = 2, 2, 1
carrier = dict(vr=[0.5, 1.0], vx=[-1.0, 1.0],
               Vr2pidVr=[1.7671458676442586, 3.141592653589793],
               dVx=[2.0, 2.0], Tnorm=1.0, mu=1.0)
sig = assemble_molecular_hydrogen_collision_matrices(**carrier)
fi = np.ones((nvr, nvx, nx))
alpha = contract_molecular_hydrogen_alpha_frequencies(
    sig["SIG_CX"], sig["SIG_H2_H"], sig["SIG_H2_P"],
    fi, fi, fi, np.full(nx, 1e18), np.full(nx, 5e17))
kernel = np.asarray(carrier["vr"])[:, None] ** 2 - 2.0 * np.asarray(carrier["vx"])[None, :] ** 2
out = assemble_molecular_hydrogen_omega_frequencies(
    fi, np.full(nx, 1e18), alpha["Alpha_H2_P"], alpha["Alpha_H2_H"],
    sig["SIG_H2_H2"], np.asarray(carrier["Vr2pidVr"]), np.asarray(carrier["dVx"]),
    np.asarray(carrier["vr"]), np.asarray(carrier["vx"]), 1.0,
    np.full(nx, 0.1), np.full(nx, 0.05), fi, kernel)
assert np.array_equal(out["Omega_EL"], out["Omega_H2_P"] + out["Omega_H2_H"] + out["Omega_H2_H2"])
assert np.all(out["Omega_EL"] >= 0.0)
example.expected: The three channels aggregate to Omega_EL exactly and stay nonnegative; a non-positive density with an enabled channel raises ValueError.

Input and failure contracts, including the registered hardenings.
verification.evidence_ceiling: The maintained direct tests establish every declared output against an independent closed-form reduction oracle built over manufactured inputs (the saved packages' 1e-12-relative/1e-9-absolute budgets), the source-exact inside/outside-the-sum division ordering for the H2-H versus H2-P channels, the branch-time SIG re-contraction against a Fortran-order versus C-order discriminating carrier, the zero clamps, the exact Omega_EL channel sum, channel-switch gating, input immutability, the Wperp branch selectors (including the < 0 versus <= 0 asymmetry between the arms), and the registered fail-closed hardenings. In the environment-gated replay all six outputs agree bit for bit with the saved KN1DPy implementation pinned by SHA-256 on fixtures covering both Wperp branch paths per arm. That replay is provisional historical development evidence, not qualified-L1 provenance. No test establishes the aggregation against an external atomic-physics reference; the saved package records that residual as validation_oracle_gap.
known_limitations: The saved bundle sits in the re-review archive and KN1DPy's strict D1 qualification is withdrawn; the historical replay evidence cannot be upgraded to qualified-L1 provenance without a new strict freeze and independent review of the source project.

The registered fail-closed hardenings (positive-density gating, finite positive scalar Vth/tolerances, non-finite output gate) deliberately diverge from the saved arm's silent skip-through/NaN-returning behavior on those boundaries.

On a velocity carrier and flow targets whose drift difference is exactly zero, the source legacy sign(0)=0 makes the floored denominator 0*(...)=0.0 and the channel degenerates to NaN; the saved operator.md records this legitimate-input hazard. The port's non-finite output gate now rejects it with ValueError instead of returning NaN; whether to normalize the sign to a zero-protected np.sign form is an open expert question (registered by the saved package).
The DeltaVx_tol=0.01 and Wpp_tol=0.001 floors are source hardcoded defaults; their physical adequacy is an open expert question.
